# Eyeology

> Eyeology is a multi-location optometry clinic offering comprehensive eye exams, treatments, designer eyewear, and franchise opportunities across Ontario.

Eyeology operates clinics in Brampton, Stoney Creek, and Milton, Ontario, led by experienced optometrists including Dr. Munsa Rana, Dr. Trivedi, Dr. Gill, and Dr. Kalkat. The practice combines clinical eye care with premium eyewear retail and expansion opportunities for franchise partners.
